title: Comparing forecasting models against trivial baselines: code and results for monthly cancer mortality in São Paulo State, Brazil
description: Code, aggregated monthly series, forecasts and results for the methodological study submitted to Cadernos de Saúde Pública (Questões Metodológicas). Individual death records from the Mortality Information System (SIM/DataSUS) are public but not redistributed; the repository holds only aggregated monthly series.
